name: Elemental Strike (Combat, Mythic)
body:
Your elemental blood invigorates your weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Strike.

Benefit: Whenever you use Elemental Strike to enhance your weapons, the effect lasts for 1 minute instead of 1 round. If you expend one use of mythic power when using Elemental Strike, you can also add any one magic weapon special ability with a base price modifier of +1 from the following list to your weapons (the total base price modifier increases to +2 at 4th tier, +3 at 7th tier, and +4 at 10th tier):

burning, catalytic, corrosive, corrosive burst, cyclonic, flaming, flaming burst, frost, grounding, icy burst, igniting, quenching, rusting, shock, shocking burst, tailwind, thawing, thundering, underwater.

You can only add a special ability to a weapon if you belong to a corresponding half-elemental race.
